books.title: The Makioka Sisters
books.author: Junichiro Tanizaki
books.synopsis: In Osaka in the late 1930s, the proud but fading Makioka family struggles to find a husband for the shy, thirty-year-old Yukiko, whose arranged-marriage meetings keep falling through. Her older sister Sachiko manages the search, while the modern, headstrong youngest sister Taeko scandalizes the family with affairs of her own as the old Kansai world slips away and war approaches.
